decision: Retain v25 unchanged through its four protected open lifecycles and reserve v26 exclusively for the already-staged HIP-3 telemetry repair. Do not combine that mechanical transition with an economic portfolio redesign. The refreshed immutable prefix still assigns zero of 24 exact routes to shared-portfolio interaction replay, ten to REVISE, and fourteen to STOP-exact-contract. Do not carry the unchanged HYPE breakout contract into the economic successor merely because mixed-profile HYPE-long PnL remains slightly positive: its exact deployed-shape research is negative and its first post-cutoff current-profile HYPE long lost after costs. Reject promotion of the tested HYPE profit locks and the relaxed SPCX, SOL-continuation, and SNDK-pivot challengers. These are research decisions only; they do not stop, filter, resize, restart, close, or place any live trade.
falsifier: This revision is invalidated by an evidence hash mismatch, route identity collision, open marks being counted as closes, mixed-profile outcomes being represented as current-profile edge, a v26 strategy or risk difference beyond profile identity, execution authority in any research artifact, or failure to reproduce the 0/10/14 triage.
